advice.error: The explanation could not load. Your options above are still correct.
advice.title: Which option should you pick?

counter.body: The buyer offered {{price}}/kg. Name your price — we show what you would take home.
counter.noTip: No suggestion right now — use the mandi price as your guide.
counter.priceRequired: Enter the price per kg you want.
counter.sent: Counter-offer sent. We will tell you when the buyer replies.
counter.title: Ask for a better price

detail.cancelBody: Buyers will no longer see it, open offers on it close, and it leaves any lot that is still forming. This cannot be undone.
detail.editBody: Buyers see the change straight away.
detail.listedNow: Listed — buyers can see it now.
detail.lotsTitle: Lots this harvest is part of
detail.noOptionsBody: We are looking for buyers and nearby farmers to pool with. You will get a message when an offer comes.
detail.optionsTitle: What each option leaves in your hand
detail.seoDescription: Selling options compared by what you take home, and where this harvest is in its journey.

done.body: We are matching it with buyers and nearby farmers now. Every offer will show what you take home, compared with selling alone at the mandi.
done.draftBody: Buyers cannot see a draft. Open it and list it when you are ready.
done.title: {{harvest}} is now on MandiMate

form.check: Please check this — we could not hear it clearly.

errors.price: Enter a valid price, or leave it empty.
errors.quantity: Enter how much — more than zero.
errors.sellBy: The sell-by date must be on or after the ready date.
errors.tooLong: That is too long — please shorten it.

form.gradeHelp: Not sure? Choose “Not sure yet” — a coordinator checks it at pickup.
form.minPriceHint: Buyers never see this. We mark offers that leave you less than this, after all costs.
form.minPriceLabel: Minimum you will take home per kg
form.notesHint: e.g. Firm, bright red, sorted by size
form.when: When can it be picked up?

harvests.emptyBody: List your first harvest — it takes about a minute, or just say it out loud.
harvests.lede: Everything you have listed, what is still free to sell and what is promised.
harvests.title: Your harvests

home.emptyBody: Tell us what you harvested. We find buyers, pool small lots together and show what you take home before you agree.
home.kpiUplift: More than the mandi, per kg
home.lede: What your harvest can earn today — counted in money that reaches your hand.
home.noOptions: Offers will appear here as buyers respond. We compare each one with selling alone at the mandi.
home.optionsBody: Compared by what reaches your hand — after transport, loading, commission, rejection and the wait for payment.
home.optionsTitle: Where your harvest earns the most
home.seoDescription: Your current harvest, the best offer by net earnings and what needs your attention.
home.title: Your farm today
home.todoEmptyBody: Nothing waits on you right now. We will tell you when an offer arrives.
home.vsMandi: vs selling alone at the mandi

new.fromVoice: We filled this in from what you said. Please check the highlighted parts.
new.lede: Say it in your own words, or fill a short form. Nothing is sold until you agree.
new.modeLabel: How do you want to list?
new.photosBody: Buyers trust what they can see. Take 2–3 photos in daylight. You can skip this and add them later.
new.seoDescription: Speak or fill a short form to list your harvest.
new.title: List a harvest
new.voiceHint: Tap the mic and say what you have — for example: “400 kilo tomatoes, ready tomorrow, good quality, sell within 5 days.”

options.acceptBody: {{buyer}} buys at this price. We then arrange pickup and track the payment for you.
options.accepted: Offer accepted. We will plan the pickup next.
options.baselineNote: What you would keep selling alone at the mandi — the yardstick for every offer.
options.rejectBody: The buyer is told you said no. Your harvest stays listed for other offers.
options.waitingBuyer: Waiting for the buyer to reply.
